```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# ==============================================================================
# SETUP CHUNK
# ==============================================================================
# Load required packages and pre-computed objects.
# This report performs NO computation - all objects are loaded from RDS files
# generated by Workflows 05-06.
# ==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load pre-computed objects
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

all_summaries <- readRDS(params$summary_rds)
all_plots <- readRDS(params$plots_rds)

# Load study parameters (with fallback defaults)
if (file.exists(params$study_params_path)) {
  study_params <- yaml::read_yaml(params$study_params_path)
} else {
  study_params <- list(
    study_name = "Bat Acoustic Monitoring Study",
    study_location = "Study Site"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Convert snake_case to Title Case
snake_to_title <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title()
}

# Generate standardized caption
make_caption <- function(plot_name, category) {
  base <- snake_to_title(plot_name)
  sprintf("%s. Generated from standardized pipeline output.", base)
}

# Null coalescing operator (if not already available)
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check for optional data availability
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

has_species <- !is.null(all_plots$species) && length(all_plots$species) > 0
has_variance <- !is.null(all_summaries$variance_components)
has_hourly <- !is.null(all_summaries$hourly_summary_overall)

# Extract key metadata
study_name <- study_params$study_name %||% "Bat Acoustic Monitoring Study"
study_location <- study_params$study_location %||% "Study Site"
```

# Study Overview

This report presents results from the **`r study_name`** conducted at `r study_location`.

This document was auto-generated by the KPro Masterfile Pipeline. All plots and statistics were computed in upstream workflows and are presented here without modification. The report is designed for scientific review, auditing, and archival purposes.

## Study Parameters

```{r}
#| label: tbl-study-params

# Build study parameters table from metadata
study_summary <- all_summaries$study_summary

tibble::tibble(
  Parameter = c(
    "Study Name",
    "Location", 
    "Detectors",
    "Detector-Nights",
    "Total Recording Hours",
    "Total Calls Detected"
  ),
  Value = c(
    study_name,
    study_location,
    as.character(study_summary$n_detectors),
    format(study_summary$n_detector_nights, big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.1f", study_summary$total_hours),
    format(study_summary$total_calls, big.mark = ",")
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Summary") %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Parameter) %>%

  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Value) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16)
  )
```

## Processing Pipeline

This report was generated through the following automated pipeline stages:

1.  **Data Ingestion (Workflow 01)** — Raw CSV import and intro-standardization
2.  **Schema Harmonization (Workflow 02)** — Detector mapping, timezone conversion, unified schema
3.  **Template Generation (Workflow 03)** — Calls-per-night template creation
4.  **CPN Finalization (Workflow 04)** — Recording hours, status calculation
5.  **Summary Statistics (Workflow 05)** — Descriptive metrics computation
6.  **Visualization (Workflow 06)** — Exploratory plot generation
7.  **Report Generation (Workflow 07)** — This document

All data transformations are logged and reproducible. See the Reproducibility section at the end of this document for session details.

# Data Quality & Coverage

This section presents quality metrics and recording coverage across the study period. These visualizations help identify data gaps, equipment issues, and overall recording effort.

```{r}
#| label: quality-plots
#| results: asis

purrr::iwalk(all_plots$quality, function(plot_obj, plot_name) {
  
  # Emit markdown header (## for subsection)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", snake_to_title(plot_name)))
  
  # Print the plot
  print(plot_obj)
  
  # Emit caption in italics
  cat(sprintf("\n\n*%s*\n\n", make_caption(plot_name, "quality")))
})
```

## Study-Wide Summary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-study-wide

# Transpose study summary for display
study_summary <- all_summaries$study_summary

# Create a cleaner display format
tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of Detectors",
    "Detector-Nights",
    "Total Recording Hours",
    "Total Calls",
    "Overall Mean Calls/Hour",
    "Overall Median Calls/Hour",
    "Overall SD Calls/Hour",
    "Coefficient of Variation (%)",
    "% Pass Nights",
    "% Partial Nights",
    "% Fail Nights"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(study_summary$n_detectors),
    format(study_summary$n_detector_nights, big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.1f", study_summary$total_hours),
    format(study_summary$total_calls, big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.2f", study_summary$overall_mean_cph %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.2f", study_summary$overall_median_cph %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.2f", study_summary$overall_sd_cph %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", study_summary$overall_cv_pct %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", study_summary$pct_success %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", study_summary$pct_partial %||% NA),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", study_summary$pct_fail %||% NA)
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study-Wide Summary Statistics") %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Metric) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Value) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16)
  )
```

```{r}

tibble::tibble(
  Component = c("Between-Detector Variance", "Within-Detector Variance", "Total Variance"),
  Value = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", vc$pct_between),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", vc$pct_within),
    "100.0%"
  ),
  Interpretation = c(

    "Variation attributable to night-to-night changes within detectors",
    ""
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variance Components Analysis") %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Component) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Value) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Interpretation) %>%

    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hourly
#| eval: !expr has_hourly

all_summaries$hourly_summary_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Hour_Display = sprintf("%02d:00", Hour),
    Pct_Display = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_of_total)
  ) %>%
  select(Hour = Hour_Display, Calls = n_calls, `% of Total` = Pct_Display) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Hourly Activity Profile") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Calls, decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16)
  )
```
